about: 일별이익현황 [구분] 사용자지정집계 — 2026-10-13 원본 E040806 실측: 집계조건(기준일자 · 판매 · 거래처 · 품목 갈래) · 집계대상(수량 · 판매액 · 원가 · 이익 · 판매부대비용 · 부대비용포함이익 · 이익율). 거래처 / 수량 · 이익 · 이익율 → 머리 '거래처 · 수량 · 이익 · 이익율', 수량 5.00 꼴, 이익율 정수 %(더하지 않고 이익 ÷ 판매액), 끝에 합계. 출력물 머리 회사명 · 기간.

shots.name: 거래처 × 수량 · 이익 · 이익율 → 합계 줄 이익율 = 합계 이익 ÷ 합계 판매액
steps: js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === '사용자지정집계').click(); await W(400); const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="집계조건1"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(sel, 'partner'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await W(200); for (const t of ['수량', '판매액', '이익', '이익율']) { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((x) => x.innerText.trim() === t && x.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')); l.querySelector('input').click(); await W(100) } await W(400); return 'ok' })()

expect:(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report tbody tr')]; const last = rows[rows.length - 1]; if (!last || last.cells[0].innerText.trim() !== '합계') return rows.length === 1; const n = (s) => Number(s.replace(/[,%]/g, '')); const rev = n(last.cells[2].innerText), pf = n(last.cells[3].innerText); return /^\d[\d,]*\.\d\d$/.test(last.cells[1].innerText.trim()) && last.cells[4].innerText.trim() === (rev ? Math.round(pf / rev * 100) + '%' : '') })()

js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((x) => x.innerText.trim() === '전월동일기간').querySelector('input').click(); await W(2500); return [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report thead tr')].map((r) => r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).join(' / ') })()

expect:(() => { const hr = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report thead tr')]; return hr.length === 2 && hr[0].cells[0].rowSpan === 2 && /^\d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2} ~ \d{4}\/\d{2}\/\d{2}$/.test(hr[0].cells[2].innerText.trim()) && hr[1].innerText.replace(/\s+/g, '|') === '수량|판매액|이익|이익율|수량|판매액|이익|이익율' })()

expect:(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report tbody tr')]; const last = rows[rows.length - 1]; return last.cells[0].innerText.trim() === '합계' && last.cells.length === 9 })()

js:(async () => { const sel = document.querySelector('select[aria-label="집계조건2"]'); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(sel, 'month'); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })); await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 400)); return 'ok' })()

shots.name: [가로보기] 거래처 · 담당자 / 판매액 · 이익 → 담당자를 열로 펴고 거래처 줄마다 '계'
steps: js:(async () => { const W = (ms) => new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, ms)); [...document.querySelectorAll('button')].find((b) => b.innerText.trim() === '사용자지정집계').click(); await W(400); const set = (n, v) => { const sel = document.querySelector(`select[aria-label="집계조건${n}"]`); Object.getOwnPropertyDescriptor(HTMLSelectElement.prototype, 'value').set.call(sel, v); sel.dispatchEvent(new Event('change', { bubbles: true })) }; set(1, 'partner'); await W(200); set(2, 'employee'); await W(200); for (const t of ['판매액', '이익', '가로보기']) { const l = [...document.querySelectorAll('label')].find((x) => x.innerText.trim() === t && x.querySelector('input[type=checkbox]')); l.querySelector('input').click(); await W(100) } await W(400); return [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report thead tr')].map((r) => r.innerText.replace(/\s+/g, '|')).join(' / ') })()

expect:(() => { const hr = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report thead tr')]; if (hr.length !== 2) return false; const top = [...hr[0].cells]; return top[0].innerText.trim() === '거래처' && top[0].rowSpan === 2 && top.slice(1).every((c) => c.colSpan === 2) && [...hr[1].cells].every((c, i) => c.innerText.trim() === (i % 2 ? '이익' : '판매액')) })()

expect:(() => { const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('table.ec-report tbody tr')]; if (rows.length === 1) return true; const last = rows[rows.length - 1]; if (last.cells[0].innerText.trim() !== '합계') return false; for (let i = 0; i + 1 < rows.length - 1; i += 2) { if (rows[i + 1].cells[0].innerText.trim() !== rows[i].cells[0].innerText.trim() + ' 계') return false } return true })()
